claims: Darden Restaurants is closing or converting all of its remaining 28 Bahama Breeze locations.
Darden Restaurants finalized major changes to its Bahama Breeze locations by April 5, 2026.
Darden Restaurants announced that the Bahama Breeze chain is no longer a strategic priority.
Darden Restaurants announced it will shutter 14 Bahama Breeze locations.
Darden Restaurants announced it will convert the remaining 14 Bahama Breeze locations into other brands over the next 12-18 months.
The 14 Bahama Breeze locations slated for permanent closure continued operating through April 5, 2026.
Some Bahama Breeze locations closed prior to April 5, 2026, to allow for staff transfers.
14 Bahama Breeze locations are in the process of being converted into other Darden brands over the next 12-18 months.
